stories.title: Belgium: Hundreds evacuated as firefighters battle largest wildfire on record
stories.summary: A rapidly spreading wildfire in the High Fens nature reserve near Belgium's border with Germany has scorched around 2,700 hectares and forced hundreds of people to evacuate.
stories.article_text_excerpt: Skip to content Skip to main menu Skip to more DW sites https://p.dw.com/p/5ItqE The blaze is described as by officials as the largest in Belgium's modern history Image: Laurent Cavenati/Belga/AFP Advertisement Belgium is battling its largest wildfire on record which has burned around 2,700 hectares in the eastern High Fens nature reserve near the German border. On Saturday, the European Union deployed three helicopters and two water bombers as Belgium deployed additional firefighters in a bid to bring the massive blaze under control . Authorities ordered around 600 residents in parts of Waimes, Sourbrodt and Buetgenbach to evacuate as shifting winds and heavy smoke raised concerns that the fire could reach homes. Tourists were also advised to leave the area. Reinforcements were pulled from across the country to fight the blaze Image: Dha/Photo News/IMAGO "You can't see a thing anymore, there's smoke everywhere," David Rodolfs, a restaurant owner in Waimes, told the AFP news agency. A gymnasium in a neighboring municipality was opened up to offer shelter. How have firefighting efforts fared? The blaze, which broke out on Friday, has spread rapidly across peatlands and pine forests.

Hungarian authorities are sinking the two barges to raise water levels so Paks, which provides the country with more than a third of its electricity , can continue to operate normally. As a throwback to a bygone era of friendly German-Russian relations , it is the subject of fierce disagreements and has long been a bone of contention in Berlin . The massive seven-story building covering an area of almost 30,000 square meters opened in 1984. At that time, back in the days of the East German state , its role was to celebrate friendship with the Soviet Union through concerts, film screenings and book readings. It even had its own small bookstore. But now, more than 40 years later, French authorities have linked the building to possible activities by Russian intelligence services. stories.summary: Ha az idei tapasztalatok alapján észbe kapunk, alaposan és körültekintően tervezzük meg és indítjuk el a szükséges beruházásokat, akkor talán már jövőre is elkerülhető lehet a mai károk egy része.

stories.title: Egy pénzfeldobáson múlt, hogy Portlandet ma nem Bostonnak hívják
stories.summary: Az amerikai telepesek nagyon szerették a szülővárosaikról elnevezni az újonnan alapított településeket, ami egy csomó fura helyzethez és azonos nevű városokhoz vezetett.

stories.title: Máté Gábor: A színház ilyen, régen a büfékben azon röhögtek, amiért ma büntetés jár
stories.summary: Szerinte alig volt az életében olyan színházi momentum, amibe szívesen ment bele. Két évig járt pszichiáterhez, miután kiderült, hogy a Katonában a DK-sok olcsóbban kapnak jegyet.

stories.title: Trump azzal viccelt, hogy hamarosan amerikai területnek nyilvánítaná a Hormuzi-szorost
stories.summary: USS Abraham Lincoln tengerészei már több mint 260 napja vannak a tengeren, ez rekordhosszúságú időnek számít.
